scripts.build: npm run build:common && npm run build -w @qlpk/auth-service && npm run build -w @qlpk/patient-service && npm run build -w @qlpk/staff-service && npm run build -w @qlpk/appointment-service && npm run build -w @qlpk/api-gateway && npm run build -w @qlpk/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:common && concurrently -n auth,patient,staff,appt,gateway,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white "npm run dev -w @qlpk/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/patient-service" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/staff-service" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/appointment-service" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/frontend"
scripts.test: npm run build:common && node --import tsx --test packages/common/test/*.test.ts services/appointment-service/test/*.test.ts
